description:
Construct a walk-in closet in the Master Bedroom of the sample house.

Your goal is to modify the existing floor plan to create a 'room within a room'.

1. Identify the Master Bedroom (the largest bedroom in the sample house).
2. Use the 'Wall' tool to draw partition walls in one corner of the master bedroom to create a new enclosed space (approx. 1.5m x 2m or 5ft x 7ft).
3. Install a door in the new wall to connect the closet to the bedroom.
4. Place at least one storage item (shelving, wardrobe, or closet rod) inside the new closet space (found under Furniture > Bedroom > Storage).
5. Save the project.

The project must be saved for verification.
